这篇文章是给准备搬入新房、或者即将搬出当前住处的租客看的。很多押金和交接问题，不: This article is for tenants moving into a new home or out of their current one. Many deposit and handover problems don't start with a major incident; they start with missing photos, missing records, or unclear handover arrangements.
搬入第一天先记录，再收拾: On move-in day, record first, unpack second
刚拿到钥匙时最重要的事不是摆家具，而是先把房屋现状记录下来。墙面、地板、窗户、浴: When you get the keys, record the home's condition before arranging furniture. Walls, floors, windows, bathrooms, the kitchen, appliances, locks, remotes, and parking spaces are all worth documenting if they could affect the deposit or responsibilities later.
按房间顺序拍整屋照片和视频，每个房间都拍全。: Photograph and film the whole home room by room, covering every room.
把现有划痕、污渍、松动、缺件和坏掉的东西单独记录。: Record existing scratches, stains, loose fittings, missing parts and anything broken separately.
数清钥匙、门禁卡、邮箱钥匙和车库遥控器。: Count the keys, fobs, mailbox keys and garage remotes.
把入住当天发现的问题尽快发给房东、物业或主租人留痕。: Promptly send any move-in-day issues to the landlord, property manager, or primary tenant so there is a record.
押金相关信息最好一开始就对清楚: Clarify deposit details from the start
很多人到搬出前才去翻当时交了什么钱、怎么退，已经晚了。入住时就分清哪些是押金、哪: Many people only look up what they paid and how it comes back right before moving out, which is too late. At move-in, sort out which money is deposit, which is rent and which is other fees, and who handles the refund and how. The California Courts self-help site says that after a tenant moves out, the landlord has 21 days to return the whole deposit, or the rest with an itemized statement; deductions over $125 need copies of invoices or receipts.
住的过程中要把小问题养成记录习惯: Build a habit of documenting small problems while you live there
住进去之后，像漏水、墙皮脱落、电器异常、门锁卡住这类问题，发现当天就报。越早反馈: Once you live there, report leaks, peeling walls, appliance problems or sticking locks the day you notice them. Reporting early makes it easier to tell preexisting issues from problems that develop during your tenancy.
报修用短信或邮件，留下文字记录。: Make repair requests by text or email so there is a written record.
如果是合租，公共区域的损耗和清洁最好平时就说清楚。: In a shared home, clarify responsibility for common-area wear and cleaning as part of everyday arrangements.
自己添置或更换过的东西，搬走前要确认是不是需要恢复原状。: Before leaving, confirm whether anything you added or replaced must be restored.
重要沟通集中在一个聊天窗口或一串邮件里。: Keep important conversations in one chat thread or one email thread.
搬出前一周要做的事: What to do in the week before moving out
真正影响交接顺不顺的，是你搬出前一周到最后一天做了什么：清洁、修补、拍照、钥匙归: What makes the handover smooth is what you do in the last week: cleaning, small repairs, photos, returning keys and a final walk-through. After you give notice, the landlord must tell you in writing that you can ask for a pre-inspection; use it to fix what you can. If you share the place, agree in advance who handles the common areas and who shuts off power and internet last.
把自己的物品和垃圾一次清空。: Clear out all your belongings and trash in one go.
基础清洁至少要做到厨房、浴室、地面、冰箱和垃圾处理清楚。: At minimum, basic cleaning should cover the kitchen, bathroom, floors, refrigerator, and trash.
搬出当天再拍一轮全屋照片和视频，尤其是原来有争议的位置。: Take another complete set of photos and videos on move-out day, especially of any previously disputed areas.
把钥匙、门禁、停车证、包裹柜权限等交接方式提前说好。: Agree beforehand on returning keys, access fobs, parking permits, and parcel-locker access.
保留 forwarding address 和最后的转账、交接记录。: Keep your forwarding address and final payment and handover records.
合租搬出时最容易卡住的地方: Common sticking points when moving out of a shared home
如果你不是整套房一起搬走，而是中途退出合租，最容易出问题的是押金怎么结、房间由谁: If you leave a shared place on your own rather than with everyone, the usual trouble spots are settling the deposit, who takes over the room and how shared things are divided. Agree on all three in advance with the leaseholder and the next roommate, and keep it in writing.
别只拍局部：搬入当天和搬出当天都拍整屋照片和视频。: Don’t photograph only parts of the home: film the whole place on move-in day and again on move-out day.
报修不要只口头讲，也别拖到搬出时才说。: Don’t report repairs only by word of mouth, and don’t wait until move-out to raise them.
别留“之后再回来拿”的东西。: Don’t leave anything to “pick up later.”
中途退出合租时，别指望主租人自动处理押金，也别假设下一位室友一进来就能接上。: When you leave a shared place early, don’t count on the leaseholder to settle the deposit, or on the next roommate slotting right in.
照片不是为了吵架，是为了省事: Photos are there to save hassle, not start an argument
很多人觉得拍太多像不信任别人，其实完整记录往往能减少来回解释。搬入和搬出各留一套: Taking many photos may feel distrustful, but complete records often reduce explanations later. A clear set at move-in and another at move-out are more effective than trying to remember afterward how things used to look.
